reason: The v0.2 wrapper pinned the model value supplied through PLH_LOCAL_MODEL but did not verify it matched executorFamily.defaultModel in the evaluation set. A stale qwen3.5:4b environment variable therefore executed a second 4B run under a 9B-labeled evaluation set.
repair: The local frontier wrapper now takes executorFamily.defaultModel as the model source of truth, rejects a conflicting PLH_LOCAL_MODEL before cell 0, and propagates the pinned model to the adapter.
